sections.heading: CHARACTER PROFILE & CORE STACK
sections.dialogue: I bridge the gap between hard technical logic and real-time visual art. My focus spans graphics shader pipelines, Eulerian-Lagrangian fluid solvers, AWS infrastructure, and interactive installations.
list_items: Languages: Python, GLSL/HLSL, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, C++
Real-Time Visual Systems: TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine 5, P5.js, WebGL
Infrastructure & Operations: AWS Cloud Management, Linux Admin, CI/CD, Docker
Math & Physics Models: Navier-Stokes Fluid Solvers, Gerstner Waves, Shaders
